lesson: Responsive navigation must be validated at mobile viewport widths (< 640px) to prevent horizontal scrolling or overlapping flex items.

reusable_pattern.name: Mobile Navigation QA Pattern
reusable_pattern.resolution: Use `@media (max-width: 640px)` to hide non-essential secondary links, collapse into a hamburger menu, or wrap elements. Ensure the primary CTA remains visible and accessible without horizontal overflow.
